tenderSchedule.title: Repair of damaged Rotor Field Pole Body of 150MW Generators of Nagjhari Power House
tenderSchedule.description: Repair/re-conditioning of rotor field pole body/pole shoe of 150MW Generators of Nagjhari Power House including loading, unloading, transportation etc., covering all associated works required for successful completion of the work
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Generator Office KVP Nagjhari

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted

The bidder shall be a regular manufacturer/supplier /authorized service provider in India who have successfully supplied/repaired/serviced & tested rotor field pole body of 50MW or above capacity generators to any power plant/Industry in proceeding last five years. In proof of this, bidder should submit copy of single work/purchase order of total value not less than Rs. 3.75 lakhs and corresponding satisfactory performance/work done certificate issued by competent authority (in case of state/central Government/Government under taking from officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent cadre and in case of KPCL not below the rank of Chief Engineer) shall be furnished.(A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous work/purchase orders to bring the current price level of 2026-27

The bidder in his name, should have in the last five years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 7.5 Lakhs. In proof of this Turnover Certificate duly certified by Charted Accountant shall be furnished. (A weightage of 10% per year is applicable to previous annual turnover to bring the current price level of 2026-27).

Those bidders whose contracts have been terminated/fore-closed by KPCL or whose performance has not been satisfactory while executing the contract of the above within last 5 years are not eligible to participate in the bid. The bidder shall furnish an undertaking in this regard (Annexure-A). Bidders shall furnish notarized declaration in Rs. 200 Non Judicial stamp paper in Schedule G.
Any bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the bidder is registered with the Competent Authority.
